sources.title: HuMo & Chroma1-Radiance Native Support in ComfyUI
sources.snippet: Chroma 1 Radiance Developed by @LodestoneRock, Chroma1-Radiance (source) is a text-to-image model licensed under Apache-2.0, enabling commercial applications. Unlike typical approaches that use latent space generation coupled with VAE encoding/decoding—which introduces approximation loss—Radiance produces imagery directly in pixel space.

sources.snippet: Chroma1-Radiance_Repackaged is a high-fidelity image generation model specifically optimised for the Huawei Ascend AI ecosystem. It is designed to produce high-dynamic-range visuals with a focus on sophisticated lighting and 'radiance' effects, making it ideal for creative developers working within the MindSpore and CANN frameworks.
